blockers.quote: In the dark window, a dim copy of your head, with its own counter.
blockers.why: No new power rule after the halfway point: this introduces a counter over yourself, which the established rule cannot explain.
blockers.fix: Replace with: "In the dark window, your reflection watches the other counters flip."

suggestions.quote: > CHANGE: An unplanned Friday train home makes the counter climb: it counts your trains, not her years.
suggestions.fix: Match the actual turn: "> CHANGE: When you promise another Friday home, the counter climbs: it counts your future visits, not her years."

suggestions.quote: In one taste test, students were told, "This is your last chocolate."
suggestions.fix: Compress lines 53–54 into one line so the chai scene does not pause for a lecture: "Students told one chocolate was their last picked it as their favourite 64% of the time, whatever the flavour (c02)."
Make the plan large enough to earn 260: replace it with "> BUBBLE: You: "First Friday. Every month."" and show a monthly repeat on the timetable and train app.

keep.quote: And she'll be at that door. She always is.
You're not at the start of your time with her. You're at the tail end.
